name: Dalmia Industrial Development Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1982, Dalmia Industrial Development Ltd is in the business of
textile products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
DIDL is a engaged in wholesale trading of textile, fibres, construction material, and iron and steel parts. Currently, it is in the business of buying and selling of Designer Indian ethnic sarees and other allied accessories.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.88 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 369 to 81.1 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 0.26% over last 3 years.
